about: The collecta of the formulary “16th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May Your grace, we beseech You, O Lord, ever go before us and follow us, and may it make us ever intent upon good works. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
